column1: # MariaDB 11.8.8 token forms for generated compat rows: the text written for each
# terminal of sql_yacc.yy, which declares its tokens by name alone. Sources, both
# in sql/ at the pinned tag: lex.h, the keyword tables symbols[] and
# lex_token and find_keyword). A token with several spellings is written by the
# one its name holds, or the first the table lists; a word of sql_functions[] is
# its token only before a parenthesis, so a spelling of symbols[] comes first.
# (empty) is a token written as nothing; (unreachable) is a token the lexer never
# produces under the default sql_mode, so the alternatives that need it get no
# A row that names a rule gives the text other rows write where that rule stands.
# MariaDB's grammar actions look these names up while the parser runs, and an
# unknown one answers (1115, 1273, 1193, 1286, 1327) before a later syntax error
# Literals, operators and the tokens the lexer forms from other text.
